items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: you took Duke's place in his band... I was handy, and I played

ctx.x: Yeah. And colors. Ethnic... It was predominantly... I mean, Jewish-owned, but then predominantly the buyers were Blacks and Spanish and things like that. But there was a Duke Yelman(?)... See, if you couldn't go to the Cotton Club to hear Duke Ellington, you paid a quarter and went down and heard Duke Yelman(?).
